data.animaCaption: Resting one hand lightly on the wooden potting bench while cradling a white hydrangea stem with the other, she pauses with one puff sleeve slipped off her sun-warmed shoulder in flustered surprise. Dappled greenhouse sunlight filters through hanging ferns across her flushed cheeks.
data.promptProse: Framed through lush white hydrangeas and hanging ferns inside a sunlit glass conservatory, Ayachi Nene pauses beside a weathered wooden potting bench in her dusty-blue floral square-neck tea dress and pearl pendant. One loose puff sleeve slides gently off her bare shoulder as she rests one palm on the warm wood and cradles a freshly cut white hydrangea stem in her other hand, turning toward the viewer with a rosy blush under dappled afternoon greenhouse light.
data.story: 玻璃花房里蒸腾着泥土和白绣球的甜香。宁宁踩着木凳修剪高枝，脚下一滑整个人向前倾来，慌乱中一手按稳你的肩膀，微松的泡泡袖顺势滑下香肩——「呀、抓稳了……好险，刚才心跳差点漏了一拍。」
